stemMd: What is 72 km/h expressed in m/s?
explanationMd: Convert 72 km to 72000 m and one hour to 3600 s. Dividing gives 20 m/s; equivalently divide km/h by 3.6.

distractorRationale.b: This converts kilometres but not hours.
distractorRationale.a: This introduces an extra factor of ten.
distractorRationale.d: This multiplies by 3.6 instead of dividing.
